strategy: Hook with local JSONL noise, collapse into a generated finding, then prove the workflow through real dashboard evidence and end on a runnable command.

beats.purpose: Cold open with trace noise and a CLI entry point.
beats.voiceSays: Claude Code usage has patterns hiding in local history.
beats.screenShows: Floating JSONL events, timeout/error rows, ingest command.
beats.risk: Opening can be too dark if the command panel is not dominant.

beats.purpose: Convert raw traces into an explicit finding.
beats.voiceSays: The tool turns noisy traces into a concrete diagnosis.
beats.screenShows: scan jsonl -> group traces -> detect cluster -> emit finding
beats.risk: Do not show too many JSON snippets once the finding appears.

beats.purpose: First product proof: real finding and dashboard context.
beats.voiceSays: Slow calls are not a feeling; they are grouped evidence.
beats.screenShows: Diagnostics cards with a Bash timeout cluster.
beats.textSays: 第一条结论：慢调用不是感觉。
beats.risk: The screenshot text is small, so the title must carry the point.

beats.purpose: Show the product goes from diagnosis to action.
beats.voiceSays: A useful report must recommend the next command.
beats.textSays: 先判断，再给下一步动作。
beats.risk: Avoid explaining every feature; keep it as one workflow.

beats.voiceSays: The same filter follows failures, tokens, sessions, and tools.
beats.textSays: 证据跟着同一组过滤条件走。
beats.risk: A table-only shot needs a visual highlight or scan layer.

beats.voiceSays: Repeated command families reveal where the loop starts.
beats.textSays: 命令归因，不只是错误列表。

beats.purpose: Cost lands on model/session/project, not a global number.
beats.voiceSays: Cost becomes useful only when it lands on model and session.
beats.textSays: 成本最后要落到模型和会话。
beats.risk: Do not repeat one cost number across voice, title, and table.

beats.purpose: Open the output to downstream AI/debugging workflows.
beats.voiceSays: The diagnosis can move into JSON, Markdown, or tables.
beats.textSays: 把诊断交给下一步工具。
beats.risk: This can feel like a feature list; keep it transitional.

beats.purpose: End with a runnable command and repo.
beats.voiceSays: Run one command and inspect the last seven days.
beats.risk: CTA should stay quiet and concrete, not slogan-heavy.
